changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0071. Staff payroll: effective-dated compensation, monthly runs, locked pay lines, adjustments, and payment records. Index review: PK on each Id; UX_StaffCompensation_Staff_Effective keeps one open row per staff start date; UX_PayrollRuns_Tenant_Period blocks duplicate months; IX_PayrollLines_Run and IX_PayrollPayments_Line serve run detail and payment status. Performance note: every list filter leads with TenantId.
